description: Works out how much walking and exercise a dog needs per day for its age, size and energy level. Puppies (until about 12 months, large breeds 18 months): the 5-minutes-per-month-of-age rule for formal walks, up to twice a day, never above the adult amount for the dog's type. Adults: the Royal Kennel Club daily bands (up to 30 minutes, up to 1 hour, or more than 2 hours). For questions about how long to walk a puppy or a dog, or how much exercise a breed type needs. General guidance from kennel-club and vet sources (Royal Kennel Club, PDSA, AniCura), not veterinary advice.

age.description: The dog's age, in the unit below (8 weeks to 20 years).

energy.description: Breed energy: low (up to 30 min a day as an adult), moderate (up to 1 hour), high (more than 2 hours, e.g. working and herding breeds).

language.description: The language the user is writing in, as a language code (e.g. en, de, sv, pt-BR, es-MX, ja, ar). The answer comes back in that language.

size.description: small = small or medium breed (grown at about 12 months); large = large or giant breed (grown at about 18 months).

name: calculate_dog_walk_needs
title: Dog walk and exercise needs
